summary: POMDOCTOR Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for September 30, 2026. The meeting will consider terminating its ADR program and direct listing of Class A ordinary shares on Nasdaq, alongside a 10-for-1 share consolidation and corresponding authorized share capital amendments. These are routine corporate housekeeping and exchange-listing changes, not an acquisition, tender, or other special situation. The filing merely announces shareholder approval items, with no deal terms, premium, or strategic transaction. As a routine EGM notice, it falls outside special-situations categories.
